newsitem.title: USA: Chase names John Lipsky chief economist.
newsitem.headline: Chase names John Lipsky chief economist.

text.p: Chase Manhattan Corp said on Monday it has named John Lipsky as chief economist, replacing Richard Aspinwall.
Lipsky, who will also serve as director of research for Chase's Global Bank, was formerly chief economist at Salomon Brothers Inc, a unit of Salomon Inc, Chase said.

Aspinwall was named to the new position as director of public policy research, a position that advises senior management about public policy issues and specific legislative and regulatory matters that affect the financial services industry, Chase said.
